2607.14582.title: MathCoPilot: An Interactive System for Human-AI Symbiotic Paradigm of Mathematical Research
2607.14582.paper_summary: Existing LLM-based theorem provers have achieved impressive results on formal mathematics benchmarks, yet they remain confined to acting as autonomous agents that prove a stated proposition. In this paper, we propose MathCoPilot, a human-in-the-loop system that embodies a new human--AI symbiotic paradigm for mathematical research, in which the mathematician steers the high-level mathematical direction while AI agents carry out the detailed formalization and proof work under continuous human guidance. MathCoPilot unifies three core capabilities: (1) an interactive workbench where the mathematician and AI agents collaborate through a living proof blueprint that decomposes a proof into navigable steps the human can directly inspect, direct, and refine; (2) automated proving skill orchestration with adaptive knowledge base search and Lean-integrated iterative verification; and (3) topic-driven paper retrieval and automated formalization into a verified Lean knowledge base. Using MathCoPilot, we systematically compare four state-of-the-art LLMs, including Gemini~3.1~Pro, GPT-5.4, and Claude~Opus~4.7, on a FormalMATH subset and on two real PDE theorems requiring deep domain expertise, evaluating their ability to produce verified Lean~4 proofs and to identify errors in deliberately incorrect proofs. Our results show that while current models can handle undergraduate-level problems with high success rates under favorable autoformalization conditions, substantial challenges remain for domain-specific theorems requiring genuine mathematical understanding.
2607.14582.paper_summary_zh: 現有的基於LLM的定理證明器在正式數學基準上取得了令人印象深刻的成果，然而它們仍然僅限於作為自主代理來證明所陳述的命題。<lb/>在本文中，我們提出了MathCoPilot，一個人機協作系統，體現了一種新的人類與AI共生範式，用於數學研究，其中數學家引導高層次的數學方向，而AI代理在持續的人類指導下進行詳細的形式化和證明工作。<lb/>MathCoPilot統一了三個核心能力：(1) 一個互動工作台，數學家和AI代理通過一個活的證明藍圖進行合作，該藍圖將證明分解為可導航的步驟，供人類直接檢查、指導和完善；(2) 自動證明技能協調，具有自適應知識庫搜索和Lean集成的迭代驗證；以及(3) 以主題驅動的論文檢索和自動形式化到經過驗證的Lean知識庫。<lb/>使用MathCoPilot，我們系統地比較了四個最先進的LLM，包括Gemini~3.1~Pro、GPT-5.4和Claude~Opus~4.7，在FormalMATH子集以及兩個需要深厚領域專業知識的實際PDE定理上，評估它們生成經過驗證的Lean~4證明和識別故意錯誤證明中錯誤的能力。<lb/>我們的結果顯示，儘管當前模型在有利的自動形式化條件下能夠高成功率地處理本科水平的問題，但對於需要真正數學理解的領域特定定理仍然存在重大挑戰。
